==Enemies==
'''Curse''' may refer to the following enemies:
*[[Cursed Skeleton]], an enemy spawned by the [[Necromancer King]], that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]
**[[Cursed Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]

It may also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Cursed Guard]], a high health enemy spawned by the [[Penumbras]] that first appeared on Wave 14 in [[Totality Tower]]
*[[Cursed Horror]], a fast, flying enemy that first appeared on Wave 13 in [[Containment]]
*[[Cursed Horse]], a fast, high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 14 in [[Totality Tower]]
*[[Cursed Knight]], an enemy spawned by the [[Penumbras]] that first appeared on Wave 13 in [[Totality Tower]]
